t: A low-power STM32 chip with Bluetooth, Thread, Zigbee, and Matter radio support.
steps: Buy a NUCLEO-WBA55CG or B-WBA5M-WPAN board from the ST eStore or a parts distributor.
Install the Arduino IDE and add the STM32duino board package.
Pick the Nucleo WBA55CG board and upload the Blink example.
Install the Zephyr tools for radio projects.
Run the Zephyr blob fetch step for the hal_stm32 radio files.
Build and flash a Bluetooth beacon sample.
Scan for the beacon with a phone app.
meta: Open Board. From $50.90. A few stores.
